snapshot_rule: Restore the same initial snapshot before each whole session and policy; retain caches between its operations.
worker_rule: Drain and attribute background work at session end; record foreground completion and drain completion separately.
timing_boundary: Database driver execute entry until all result rows for that command are consumed; includes transport, server wait/execution and driver decoding.
sql_count: Count every executed command including setup, ID discovery, payload loading, cleanup, retry and fallback, tagged by category. Record setup separately from the timed session.
overfetch: Record unique prefetched node versions and payload bytes, whether later consumed before invalidation/session end, plus duplicate transferred bytes separately.
